data.description_en:
Seeded Whole Grain Crisps 🌾

 

Product type: Baked plant-based crisps ❄️

Net weight: 90g ⚖️

Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

 

 

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

Thin. Crisp. Built with real ingredients.

These ultra-thin crisps are baked from whole wheat flour, oats, and a blend of seeds.

No unnecessary additives — just structure, texture, and clean flavor.

Light, crunchy, and satisfying.

 

 

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT 🌾

Whole grains and seeds in every bite.

Crisp texture without excess oil.

A practical, everyday snack.

 

 

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Whole wheat flour, oats, sunflower seeds, pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds, flax seeds, olive oil, water

 

 

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: Gluten (wheat, oats), sesame
May contain traces of: Nuts, soy

 

 

NUTRITION (Per 22g serving) 🧮

Energy 133 kcal
Fat 6.2g
Carbohydrate 15.1g
Protein 4.3g

 

 

STORAGE 📌

Store in a cool, dry place.
Keep sealed to maintain crispness.

 

 

INTENDED USE / NOTES

Plant-based baked snack 🌿
No unnecessary additives
data.description_cn:
全谷种子脆片 🌾

 

产品类型：植物性烘焙脆片 ❄️

净含量：90g ⚖️

产地：中国广州 🌍

 

 

产品描述 🧾

够薄，够脆，用料真实。

采用全麦面粉、燕麦与多种种子烘焙而成。

没有多余添加，只有清晰的结构与酥脆口感。

轻盈、干净、好吃。

 

 

为什么人们会选它 🌾

全谷物与种子组合。

酥脆但不过油。

适合日常食用的简单零食。

 

 

配料表 🌱

全麦面粉、燕麦、葵花籽、南瓜籽、芝麻、亚麻籽、橄榄油、水

 

 

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：麸质（小麦、燕麦）、芝麻
可能含有微量：坚果、大豆

 

 

营养信息（每份 22g）🧮

能量 133kcal
脂肪 6.2g
碳水化合物 15.1g
蛋白质 4.3g

 

 

贮存方式 📌

置于阴凉干燥处保存。
开封后密封以保持酥脆。

 

 

食用提示

植物性烘焙零食 🌿
无多余添加
